## History

When a girl named [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally served currant wine to his daughter [Diana](../character/diana.md), Mrs. Barry blamed [Anne](../character/anne.md) and refused her initial apology, though she later visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to apologize for the misunderstanding and reconcile the girls. Later, during a party held at his house, Mr. Barry carried [Anne](../character/anne.md) home after she fell off his roof and broke her ankle while attempting a dare.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P32](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER II. > — Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P64](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0064)
